[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Samuel William Glasgow''' was born '''29 May 1831''' in County Armagh, Ireland (date reported in a family Bible source on his FamilySearch profile).<ref>Legacy NFS user-submitted source citing a family Bible: birth 29 May 1831, Armagh; attached on FamilySearch profile K26R-9PZ.</ref> He lived in the '''Drumgreenagh''' area of Derrynoose parish, Armagh, and formed a family there in the 1870s.

Samuel married '''Maria Gardiner/Gardner''' (marriage not yet located in the civil indexes; the couple is identified as parents on multiple birth registrations). Their known children were born in Drumgreenagh/Keady/Armagh registrations between 1871 and 1880 (see Children, below).<ref name="John1871">"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," birth of '''John Glasgow''', 12 Apr 1871, Drumgreenagh, Armagh; parents '''Samuel Glasgow''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QGYW-39GR</ref><ref name="Sam1872">"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," birth of '''Samuel David Glasgow''', 18 Mar 1872, Drumgath/Newry (Armagh reg.); parents '''Samuel David Glasgow''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QGY7-2XDS</ref><ref name="Mat1873">"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," birth of '''Matilda Glasgow''', 12 Apr 1873, Drumgreenagh, Armagh; parents '''Samuel''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QPJX-CFJ7</ref><ref name="Sel1875">"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," birth of '''Selina Elizabeth Glasgow''', 22 Aug 1875, Drumgreenagh, Armagh; parents '''Samuel''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QGY7-2X7N</ref><ref name="Jam1878">"Ireland, Births & Baptisms, 1620–1881," birth of '''James William Glasgow''', 26 Apr 1878, Drumgreenagh, Armagh; parents '''Samuel''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FPTD-BM7</ref><ref name="Emi1880">"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," birth of '''Emily Glasgow''', 11 May 1880, Armagh reg.; parents '''Samuel''' & '''Maria (Gardiner) Glasgow'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:QPL2-4DNY</ref>

Samuel died in County Armagh in the first quarter of 1896 (registered age '''64''').<ref>"Ireland, Civil Registration Indexes, 1845–1958," death of '''Samuel Glasgow''', Q1 1896, Armagh, vol. 1, p. 40; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FT88-1T5</ref> The '''Calendar of Wills and Administrations''' (Armagh) records a probate entry dated '''8 March 1896''' naming his widow '''Maria Glasgow''' and '''Ephriam Hughes'''.<ref>"Ireland, Calendar of Wills and Administrations, 1858–1920," Armagh, entry dated 8 Mar 1896, for '''Samuel Glasgow'''; beneficiaries '''Maria Glasgow''' and '''Ephriam Hughes'''; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:KZ58-84K</ref>

== Residence ==
Multiple children’s birth registrations place the family in '''Drumgreenagh''' townland, Derrynoose (Keady registration district), County Armagh, in the 1870s–1880s.<ref name="John1871" /><ref name="Mat1873" /><ref name="Sel1875" /><ref name="Jam1878" />

== Parentage ==
Samuel is currently linked as a son of '''John Glasgow''' (~1794–1849) of Drumgreenagh on the working tree. While the geographic and onomastic evidence fits (same townland; repeated use of given names), '''no direct record naming Samuel’s father has yet been located'''. A 23 Mar 1870 index entry associates the names '''Samuel Glasgow''' and '''John Glasgow''', but the underlying image/context has not been reviewed to confirm that this is a father–son relationship (could be witness or informant).<ref>"Ireland, Civil Registration, 1845–1913," index entry referencing '''Samuel Glasgow''' & '''John Glasgow''', 23 Mar 1870; FamilySearch ARK: https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:C9RV-Y5T2</ref> Until a marriage record, church baptism, deed, or probate explicitly names Samuel’s father, keep the connection to John as '''uncertain'''.

== Death & Probate ==
* Death registered Q1 1896, Armagh, age 64 (b. c.1831/2).<ref>See civil registration index citation above.</ref>
* Probate/administration dated 8 Mar 1896 at Armagh; beneficiaries '''Maria Glasgow''' and '''Ephriam Hughes'''. Note: probate date is not always the date of death; consult the calendar entry/image for exact wording.<ref>See Calendar of Wills citation above.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3439]] is assessed at 64% (probable). Samuel’s 1831 birth, Drumgreenagh residence and same-surname family context make John a plausible father. The held children’s registrations prove Samuel’s own adult family, while the profile explicitly says no record yet names his father; same holding is circumstantial evidence.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Locate Samuel’s marriage to Maria Gardiner or a baptism naming his father.
